commentTranslate.description: This extension helps developers translate comments, strings, code hints, error messages, and variable names in their code.
commentTranslate.command.toggleDocumentB: Toggle comment browsing mode for the current document
commentTranslate.command.translateForCop: Translate selected text and display in GitHub Copilot Chat
commentTranslate.configuration.concise: Concise mode.If on, only pressing Ctrl or Command will trigger floating translation
commentTranslate.configuration.source: Translate servcie source. Google, Bing, Baidu have been built-in.
commentTranslate.configuration.markdownS: When parsing Markdown code blocks, use TextMate scope matching as a fallback after fenced-code detection.
commentTranslate.configuration.mutualTra: Enable mutual translate. When enabled, if the detected language of the input text matches the target language, the translation direction will be swapped automatically.

commentTranslate.configuration.sub2api.a: API key for the sub2api gateway. Leave empty if it needs no authentication.

commentTranslate.configuration.sub2api.m: Model name exposed by the sub2api gateway.
commentTranslate.configuration.sub2api.t: Sampling temperature for sub2api. 0 keeps terminology stable.
